{
  "window_id": "w0027",
  "observed_failures": [
    "amount_incorrect on 074.jpg: predicted 702.00 (likely picked up a non-total number via multi-variant voting fallback instead of the true grand total)",
    "amount_incorrect on 077.jpg: predicted 23.26 (picked 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of the final rounded TOTAL 23.25 appearing on the next bold line)",
    "amount_incorrect on 078.jpg: predicted empty/null (OCR produced mangled 'GrandTota.' / 'Total — 92:80' tokens; keyword+regex missed the Grand Total 92.80)",
    "date_incorrect on 034.jpg: predicted 2018-08-09 (likely day/month swap or month misread; receipt date was interpreted with wrong format ordering)"
  ],
  "root_causes": [
    "image-ocr skill's priority tiers treat 'TOTAL' (generic) and specific labels like 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' at the same priority as the final 'TOTAL:' / 'Grand Total' line; when multiple candidates match the same tier, there is no rule to prefer the LAST / bottom-most occurrence or to prefer a bold/standalone 'TOTAL:' line over an inline 'Total (Inclusive ...)' line.",
    "Multi-pass OCR voting across preprocessing variants picks a majority numeric value without weighting by (a) which variant actually matched a priority keyword and (b) priority tier of the match; this lets a non-total number (e.g., a line total or subtotal from a noisier variant) outvote the correct grand total.",
    "Keyword regex requires exact whitespace between 'GRAND' and 'TOTAL' and between 'TOTAL' and 'RM'; OCR frequently emits 'GrandTotal', 'GrandTota.', or 'Total:' with punctuation/colon noise, so specific tiers silently fail and the engine falls back to generic 'TOTAL' which hits the wrong line.",
    "Two-line fallback accepts the last number on the next non-empty line without validating that the number has a decimal part; this lets noisy tokens like '92:80', '20', or OCR-split integers be accepted as monetary totals.",
    "Date extraction does not disambiguate DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY using contextual signals (e.g., Malaysian receipts are DD/MM/YYYY, two-digit day > 12 forces DD-first); when both components are <=12 the earlier pattern in the list wins arbitrarily.",
    "No bias toward summary region: amount search scans the whole receipt instead of restricting / up-weighting lines after a 'SUB TOTAL'/'TAX'/'GST' block, where the authoritative final total appears."
  ],
  "skill_defects": [
    "image-ocr: Total-amount extraction rules are underspecified for receipts that contain multiple TOTAL-like lines (e.g., 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' followed by a final 'TOTAL:'); no tie-breaker on 'take the last matching line within the lowest-priority tier that still appears in the summary block'.",
    "image-ocr: Keyword patterns are too strict about whitespace and punctuation around GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL RM / NET TOTAL, so common OCR artifacts (missing space, trailing colon, dot after 'Tota') defeat the specific tiers and force a worse fallback.",
    "image-ocr: Multi-pass voting is described but the aggregation rule is not keyword-aware — it is specified as majority over raw numbers, not over (priority_tier, value) pairs with priority_tier dominating.",
    "image-ocr: The 'two-line fallback' lacks a validity filter (must contain a '.' with two decimals, or an explicit RM/$ prefix) to avoid picking up order IDs, times (e.g., '92:80' misread), or quantities.",
    "image-ocr: Date extraction lists ambiguous patterns in a fixed order without a locale/context rule; there is no instruction to prefer DD/MM when a 4-digit year follows two <=31 numbers and the receipt language suggests Malaysian/SG/UK format.",
    "image-ocr: No guidance to restrict total search to the summary region (lines at/after keywords like SUB TOTAL, TAX, GST, ROUNDING, when present), which would eliminate most false positives from itemized line totals."
  ],
  "repair_recommendations": [
    "In image-ocr: tighten total-amount extraction to require, within each priority tier, selection of the LAST matching non-excluded line in the receipt (bottom-up), not the first; and when multiple matches exist in the generic TOTAL tier, prefer a line whose keyword appears as a standalone label ('TOTAL:' / 'TOTAL' at line start or after whitespace only) over inline occurrences like 'Total (Inclusive of GST)'.",
    "In image-ocr: relax keyword regex to tolerate OCR noise — allow optional punctuation and missing whitespace, e.g., match GRAND\\s*TOTAL, TOTAL\\s*[:.]?\\s*RM, NET?T\\s*TOTAL, and treat 'Tota[l1I.]' as TOTAL; keep exclusions (SUBTOTAL, TAX, GST, SST, DISCOUNT, CHANGE, CASH TENDERED/RECEIVED/PAYMENT, ROUNDING) checked first.",
    "In image-ocr: redefine multi-pass OCR aggregation as priority-aware voting — for each variant, compute (priority_tier, value); choose the candidate with the lowest priority_tier number (most specific), breaking ties by (a) frequency across variants, then (b) presence of two decimal digits, then (c) occurrence latest in the receipt. Do NOT majority-vote raw numbers across variants.",
    "In image-ocr: add a validity filter to the two-line fallback — only accept the next-line number if it matches r'\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}' or is prefixed by RM/$; reject bare integers and time-like tokens with ':'.",
    "In image-ocr: introduce a 'summary region' heuristic — once a line matching SUB\\s*TOTAL or TAX|GST|SST is seen, prefer total-amount candidates found at or after that line; if none, fall back to full-receipt scan. Document this explicitly in the skill.",
    "In image-ocr: strengthen date extraction with a disambiguation rule — if a date has form A/B/YYYY or A-B-YYYY with A,B both <=12, default to DD/MM/YYYY for receipt-style documents; if A>12 force DD-first; if B>12 force MM-first; always validate month in 1–12 and day in 1–31 for that month. Add this as explicit guidance, not just regex order.",
    "In image-ocr: document that total_amount must be serialized as a string with exactly two decimals using f'{v:.2f}' and stored under object dtype so pandas does not coerce to float; reinforce that failure yields Python None (empty cell), never '' or 'None'.",
    "In xlsx: add a brief cross-reference note that when writing OCR-derived string columns (e.g., monetary strings), use object dtype and verify by reading back the file to confirm total_amount cells are strings like '47.70' rather than numeric 47.7; recommend a post-write sanity check that opens the workbook and asserts cell types for the predicted column.",
    "In openai-vision / image-ocr: note that for low-quality receipts where tesseract keyword matching fails (e.g., 'GrandTota.'), a vision-model fallback focused only on the summary block can be used to extract the final total; keep this as an optional escalation, not default, to control cost.",
    "Keep pdf and video-frame-extraction skills unchanged; they are not implicated by this failure window."
  ],
  "confidence": 0.62
}
